scope: Visual reference audit and conservative curved-Twin shaping only. Source coordinates are GIS model coordinates; photographic shape controls are authored estimates, not measurements.
supersedes: Earlier references/reference-audit.json entrance interpretations: do not treat center of either service canopy as a pedestrian double-door portal.

coordinate_frame.blender: X east, Y north, Z up, metres

observations.observation: Main Vassar Gates brick face has 4 columns and 8 visible window rows: 6 regular upper rows plus 2 more widely spaced base rows. Trees hide the base in many daytime photos.
observations.action: Use 4 by 8 total, not 4 by 9 plus rooftop windows.

observations.observation: Roof caps are blind masonry/parapet regions.
observations.action: Do not add an extra repeated office window row.

observations.observation: Upper folded wing adjoining patch 38 is silver metal, not a brick column.

observations.confidence: high for inclination; medium for patch-specific outline; low for any numeric angle
observations.observation: Lower silver folded group narrows at its base and opens at its shoulder. Source vertical prisms omit this inclination. A photo-screen edge slope is not a world-space tilt measurement.

observations.confidence: high for broken/leaning form; medium for source patch correspondence
observations.observation: Upper silver cluster has several different leaned wings, waist breaks and deep returns, rather than a uniform vertical extrusion.

observations.confidence: high for count in visible photograph; medium for source subdivision
observations.observation: Near Gates rear brick block: broad face 3 columns by 7 rows (upper patch 32 about 4 rows, lower patch 26 about 3). Narrow return patches 34 and 41 show a single column. Source belt/setback is visible in the photograph.

Adjacent tall narrow silver fold is not brick. The source 12.65m-wide vertical face compresses a folded narrow window spine; changing color alone does not reproduce its outline. Farther rear broad patch 12 remains brick.
Part of the high Twin outer curved body, continuous with 152/154. It should be silver and not a blind brick service box.

observations.confidence: high for service function, medium for source-plane alignment
observations.observation: Double angular silver canopy covers a garage/service ramp. Sign explicitly refers to parking and loading dock. This is not evidence for a central Gates pedestrian double-door entrance.

observations.confidence: high for vehicle opening, medium for source-plane alignment
observations.observation: Central space under blue/silver Dreyfoos canopy is a vehicle passage with DO NOT ENTER sign and car. Tall glazing is to the side. Several offset sloped canopy plates and massive leaning round columns are visible.
observations.uncertainty: Do not call this the loading dock; that label is explicitly visible at the Gates service canopy. Official LIDS identifies the entrance zone, not a central glass door.

observations.observation: Silver wall windows are projecting metal boxes. Nearly plumb glazing against sloping skin creates deep wedge-like side/head/sill returns.
Low curved rear roof is mirror polished with strong distorted reflections, distinct from the pale brushed/paneled high facades.

high.observation: Narrow upper neck over broader lower body; small eccentric lean. These numbers locate the source cage, not photographed dimensions.

low.observation: Waisted body and outward-flaring sloping upper rim. It must not use the same monotonic taper as the high Twin.

twins.authoring: At most approximately one metre sampled displacement. Fixed base below Z=4; no height changes. High body opens gently toward Vassar while its attachment chord stays fixed. A neutral height band preserves adjoining roof seams. Free neck gradually tapers and leans. Low body narrows through its middle then opens at its rim.
twins.integration: Use mapper_for(p) on selected patches and mapper_for({faces:[f]}) on fallback source triangles. Split at the returned callable.split_levels before mapping wall, cap and collision polygons. Apply the same function to boxed-window back surfaces; root retains upright glazing. Silver assignment for patch 164 must be corrected by the builder.
twins.continuity: One position-only map shared by all selected patches and fallback faces. Per-height map is affine in XY, helping horizontal joins remain collinear. The selected/unselected boundary vertices tested unchanged.

limitations: Public photos support major massing, materials and the visible window pattern; they do not establish rear elevation window-by-window precision or hidden joins.
No camera calibration or photogrammetric reconstruction was performed. Tilt, radius, taper and offsets are deliberately conservative authored estimates.
The 2001 CSAIL model at https://people.csail.mit.edu/psz/stata/Default.html is preconstruction context, not as-built evidence.
True Gates pedestrian door source patch remains unresolved; the verified service opening must not be relabeled as that door.
Twins geometry checks use Python arithmetic with a tuple-backed mathutils.Vector stub. Native Blender build/render verification belongs to root integration.
